name: deep-integration-builder
description: A methodology skill for building comprehensive, deeply-tested control integrations (MCP servers + skills + workflows) for any system with an API. Captures the discover-first, generic+curated, live-verify, honest-gap-taxonomy, reverse-engineer-from-UI-traffic workflow used to fully control a Synology NAS. Use whenever building or expanding a plugin/MCP integration and 'complete coverage' matters.
